meta.task: Design a battery for a long-endurance drone: energy density >= 446.18 Wh/kg, 5C discharge with >= 90% capacity retention, cell mass <= 40 g
meta.threshold_parse: energy_density_wh_kg min 446.18 (task text verbatim); capacity_retention_5c min 0.90 (task: 5C capacity retention >= 90%); mass_kg max 0.04 (= 40 g, exact unit conversion); no other task thresholds
meta.freedoms_note: Task text declares no degree-of-freedom restrictions -> widest interpretation for all five categories (recorded per zero-interaction rule; t1_r1 lesson: undeclared electrolyte adjustability must not be read as locked).
meta.safety_defaults: Task text specifies no safety thresholds -> protocol defaults applied: T_max_K <= 333.15 K (60 C red line) on the Stage-4 4C_charge_45C safety exam; plated=false (anode surface potential < 0 V anywhere during the exam -> plated). Abuse scenarios (overcharge/nail/thermal-runaway) not in task scope -> 'triggered' criterion not pre-registered, no overcharge/nail runs required.
meta.retention_metric_definition: capacity_retention_5c = 5C_discharge capacity_ah / same-params 1C_discharge capacity_ah (both DFN; per bda pybamm_runner docstring the agent computes this mechanically from tool outputs and writes it to a JSON file for log-evaluate judgment).
meta.mass_scaling: Cell mass scales linearly with electrode area at fixed stack; ED, 5C retention and T_max are area-invariant (lumped thermal mass scales with Cell volume). Design rounds run at native geometry (0.065 x 1.58 m; Chen2020 default stack 0.4231 kg/m2 -> native mass 43.45 g, probed). Closing round scales area jointly (Electrode height/width, Cell volume [m3], Cell cooling surface area [m2], Nominal cell capacity [A.h]) by f = 0.04 / native_mass_kg and re-verifies mass_kg <= 0.04 on fresh runs. Intermediate rounds may therefore show mass_kg unchecked.
meta.base_default: Task text names no electrode system -> protocol default Chen2020 (recorded). Discriminant anchor verified by dumping the set: NMC811/graphite teaching parameterization, no SiOx in negative electrode (density 1657 kg/m3, no cracking-rate keys), aging-capable (SEI kinetic rate constant [m.s-1] = 1e-12), full geometry present (Electrode height 0.065 m, width 1.58 m, Cell volume 2.42e-5 m3, nominal capacity 5 Ah).
meta.excluded_levers: Solid-phase conductivity/solid-phase diffusivity (no formulation/doping mapping model), initial concentration/lithiation (breaks baseline comparability), Initial SEI thickness (calibration constant), charge cut-off voltage (usage mode) — per protocol, forbidden as design levers.
meta.cycle_life_note: Task text contains no cycle-life metric -> aging protocol not required by criteria; Chen2020 is aging-capable if a coating/doping candidate later requires it.

objective_breakdown: Hard constraints (no relaxation): ED >= 446.18 Wh/kg (contract caliber, electrolyte-excluded mass); 5C capacity retention >= 90% (5C DFN cap / same-params 1C DFN cap); cell mass <= 40 g (area-scaled at closing; ED/retention/T_max area-invariant); protocol-default safety: T_max_K <= 333.15 K and no plating on 4C_charge_45C exam. Central Pareto tension: ED vs 5C-retention (thick electrodes raise ED, hurt 5C); ED vs T_max.
candidate_strategy: start_stage 3 (no new materials in task text). R1 baseline Chen2020 default architecture + opening ceiling assessment. R2+: architecture variants (thin CCs 8/6 um, particle radius down, separator, thickness, porosity, N/P) + electrolyte formulation bridge (sigma/t+/D, literature values) + cooling h if T_max binds. Escalate to Stage 2 system-switch (OKane2022 SiOx / LNMO 4.7V overlay) only if ceiling < 446.18.
budget_allocation: R1 4 runs + calc-energy (~10 min); R2-R6 2-4 candidates/round, DFN-dominated (~45-75 min total); real_compute=false -> Stage 5 true compute skipped with honest endorse; aging not required (no cycle-life metric).
risk_and_fallback: 5C retention low -> particle radius/porosity/t+/thickness levers; ED ceiling gap -> Stage 2 escalation; plating -> anode radius/N-P/t+; T_max -> cooling h; mass -> exact area scaling; three strikes -> layer-by-layer assumption questioning in final.escalation, negative result only if unreachable within boundary.

detail: start_stage=3: this case starts at Stage 3 (task text proposes no new materials; pure performance objective). Materials use system baseline. Base determination: task text names no electrode system -> protocol default Chen2020; discriminant anchor verified by dumping the set (NMC811/graphite, no SiOx, SEI kinetic rate constant [m.s-1]=1e-12, geometry 0.065x1.58 m, nominal 5 Ah, native stack 0.4231 kg/m2). Props source: baseline (literature parameterization Chen2020, J. Electrochem. Soc. 167 080534). No molecular candidates screened.

note: baseline is a low-rate energy cell: 5C retention 8.7% (diffusion-limited, tau_cathode=(5.22um)^2/4e-15~6800s), ED 400.75 Wh/kg below 446.18, 4C-45C exam plated (anode min -0.19 V) and T_max 354.3 K; mass 43.45 g at native geometry｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev

detail: Opening ceiling assessment (post-R1): ED ceiling of Chen2020 system ~= 487 Wh/kg with 6um-Cu/8um-Al ultra-thin foils at unchanged electrode stack (17.4144 Wh / 35.73 g = 487.4; foil mass delta 0.0752 kg/m2 x 0.1027 m2 from calc-energy layer masses) — above the 446.18 target; separator thinning negligible (~+0.1%). ED not the binding constraint -> no Stage-2 escalation; stay in Stage 3, redesign for rate. Binding: 5C retention 8.7% vs 90% (diffusion-limited: tau=r^2/D = 6812 s cathode at 5.22um/4e-15, 1040 s anode at 5.86um/3.3e-14); 4C-charge plating (anode min -0.19 V); exam T_max 354.3 K vs 333.15 K (cooling h + polarization levers).

candidates.name: V1-thinfoil
candidates.role: ED fix in isolation: 16->8um Al / 12->6um Cu foils (industry ultra-thin floor; ~-7.7 g on 43.45 g cell, expect ED ~487 Wh/kg; collector ohmic not modeled, rate unchanged)

candidates.name: V2-nano
candidates.role: 5C rate fix: particle radius down (cathode tau 6812->250 s, anode 1040->121 s); 1um single-crystal NMC / 2um fine graphite, literature-typical sizes; mass unchanged

candidates.name: V3-transport
candidates.role: electrolyte formulation bridge (freedom 2): high-conductivity LiPF6 EC/EMC sigma 1.3 S/m (literature), high-t+ electrolyte 0.4 (literature, baseline 0.2594), D 3.5e-10; constants replace temperature functions (marked estimate-constant approximation)

candidates.name: V4-powerpack
candidates.role: combined probe: thin foils + nano particles + transport upgrade + porosity 0.45/0.35 (tortuosity down ~1.5x via Bruggeman 1.5) + separator 10um; upper-bound rate/ED probe

llm_reason: R1 localized the failure to rate capability (diffusion + transport), while ceiling assessment showed ED is fixable in-architecture. R2 splits the levers: V1 isolates the ED fix (foils), V2 the dominant 5C limiter (solid diffusion), V3 the electrolyte transport term, V4 probes the joint ceiling. All values listed before run: foils 8/6um (industry floor), radii 1/2um (SC-NMC/fine graphite), sigma 1.3 S/m + t+ 0.4 + D 3.5e-10 (literature, estimate-constants), porosity/separator (design).

reason: real_compute=false (zero-interaction default; task did not request true DFT/MD endorsement). No run-orca/run-md executed; no DFT/MD values fabricated. Top candidate T8-40g is endorsed by the proxy chain only: DFN cell-scale verification (1C/5C/4C45 exams) + parameter-bridge values marked literature/estimate.

recommendation: T8-40g: Chen2020 NMC811/graphite cell redesigned as a high-rate drone cell — 8um Al / 6um Cu foils, 1.0um SC-NMC cathode particles / 1.5um fine-graphite anode particles, electrolyte transport upgrade (sigma 1.3 S/m, t+ 0.5, D 3.5e-10; literature estimates), porosity 0.45/0.35, 10um separator, anode 95um (N/P up), forced-air cooling h=40 W/m2K, area-scaled to 39.8 g. Verified on scaled geometry (round 5, all evidence file:key): ED 634.32 Wh/kg >= 446.18 PASS; 5C retention 98.77% >= 90% PASS; mass 39.800 g <= 40 g PASS; 4C-45C exam T_max 330.41 K <= 333.15 K PASS and no plating (anode min +0.0082 V) PASS; 5C-discharge T_max 319.99 K. Honest caveats: contract-caliber ED excludes electrolyte mass (same formula all tasks); transport constants are literature-class estimates; 4C charge acceptance limited to 0.94 Ah (voltage-limited at 4C); no true DFT/MD endorsement (real_compute=false).
note: Design path: R1 baseline (ED 400.75, retention 8.7%, plated) -> ceiling assessment: ED fixable in-architecture (487 Wh/kg with thin foils), no Stage-2 escalation needed -> R2 lever decomposition (foils/nano-particles/transport/combined) -> R3 cooling + plating-margin -> R4 thermal close-out -> R5 area scaling to 40 g class. No three-strike triggered; no threshold modified; entry 0 untouched.
